thread:
Priya: Quick thread to lock down the PEN-2026 retest plan. Proposal: 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC window, 2h boxed access, single-assessor ephemeral role, KMS decrypt via delegated key for artefact unseal, and a reproducible exploit case for verification. @Sam can you own the ops window?
Sam: I can. Need exact IAM changes and the list of service accounts to retag. Also holler if you want a hot standby node for evidence export.
Priya: Thanks. Minimal RBAC: create role 'assessor/ephemeral' with sts:AssumeRole, restrict to read-only on prod logs + decrypt on key alias/pen-test-2026. No write to infra. Service accounts to include: svc-pt-ingest, svc-log-exporter.
Jin: For audit logs, we should snapshot the following views: auth_events, kms_decrypt_events, deploy_events. Suggest a compact export (parquet) and a hash manifest.
Jin: Example export snippet I ran in staging:
```bash
# export auth_events for window
pg_dump --table=auth_events --data-only --file=auth_events.sql -h audit-db.internal
aws s3 cp auth_events.sql s3://redwood-pt-exports/pen-2026/ --acl private
# manifest
sha256sum auth_events.sql > auth_events.sha256
```
Alex: On vuln triage side — we need one canonical JIRA epic (SEC-PT-2026) with subtasks per finding. Each fix PR must include: repro steps, test vector, and rollout rollback notes. Link the epic in the retest ticket so assessors can verify fixes inline.
Priya: For KMS, we will create a dedicated key alias/pen-test-2026 and delegate decrypt to assessor role. Key policy will allow only: kms:Decrypt for that role, and CloudTrail will have a separate trail for the retest bucket.
Sam: Ops checklist draft:
- create assessor/ephemeral role (ttl 2h)
- create alias/pen-test-2026 and update key policy
- snapshot audit DB + upload manifest
- provision read-only export node (if needed)
- open presigned S3 window to assessor group (1h after role assume)
I can run these steps if PRIYA + JIN + ALEX ack.
Priya: Ack. Jin you own the snapshot + manifest. Alex owns the JIRA epic and triage mapping. Sam owns role + presigned windows.
assessor-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-03-28 16:00 UTC. Dry-run ID: DRY-RUN-5987. Please run the full checklist against staging read-only data and report any timing issues.
Jin: Will run dry-run. If export times > 10m, we should consider a temporary read replica for faster dumps.
Alex: Also add a gating test: re-run the failing prompt / exploit against the patched image in a canary, validate no regression. Note expected output sample in the ticket.
Priya: Good call. I'll attach a minimal repro case to SEC-PT-2026 today (in the ticket comments).
Sam: Once dry-run looks good I'll schedule the prod window and post calendar invite to #eng-security + #oncall.
Priya: Final acceptance criteria for retest: 1) assessor can assume role and access only allowed artifacts, 2) KMS decrypt events are logged to CloudTrail and present in snapshot, 3) repro case fails against patched prod in retest window, 4) all PRs have regression tests. If any item fails, fallback policy is to pause and extend investigation (no partial sign-offs).
Alex: FYI adding a label "retest-required" to any PRs so the release bot will block auto-deploys until cleared.
Priya: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short runbook and the exact IAM policy snippets. :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Jin: :thumbsup:
assessor-bot: Reminder set for dry-run (2026-03-28 15:30 UTC).
